threshold_selection_method: Grid search over quantiles & linear space maximizing F1-score on 15% validation split (1,181 sequences)

missing_data_behavior.buffer_action: Clears the active sensor's 30-step rolling window to prevent sequence corruption from data gaps.

duplicate_timestamp.behavior: Rejected when (station_id, sensor_id, timestamp) matches the most recent record. Buffer is not duplicated or advanced.

stale_timestamp.behavior: Rejected when incoming timestamp is older than the most recent timestamp for that sensor. Buffer chronological order is preserved.

unsupported_station.behavior: Rejected when station_id != 'MTR'. Only Maitri is supported in current scope.

unsupported_sensor.behavior: Rejected when sensor_id is not in supported_sensors.

schema_violation.behavior: Rejected when payload structure or field types fail contract validation.

functions: process_backend_payload(service: MaitriMLService, payload: Union[Dict, str]) -> Dict[str, Any]

known_limitations.synthetic_data_only: All models, thresholds, and evaluations are based strictly on synthetic telemetry. No real Antarctic telemetry was available or used.
known_limitations.no_field_claims: No claim of real-world Antarctic telemetry validation, field deployment readiness, production SLAs, or certified reliability is made.
known_limitations.stuck_value_detection: STUCK_VALUE anomalies are not reliably detected by the single-threshold LSTM reconstruction loss (5% test recall; short stuck-value scenario evaluated as NORMAL). Heuristic variance classification is recommended for future production hardening.
known_limitations.false_positive_tradeoff: The frozen threshold (0.017674) prioritizes spike (100%) and drift (84.67%) recall over false-alarm suppression, resulting in a 48.15% FPR on normal synthetic diurnal fluctuations on the test split.

integration_notes.recommended_usage: Instantiate MaitriMLService once upon backend application startup. Route incoming sensor records via process_backend_payload(service, payload) or service.process_telemetry(adapt_backend_input(payload)).
integration_notes.data_flow: Backend telemetry JSON → adapt_backend_input() → TelemetryInput → MaitriMLService.process_telemetry() → LSTM inference → Anomaly status & type → TelemetryInferenceOutput → adapt_backend_output() → Backend JSON response
integration_notes.statefulness: MaitriMLService is stateful (maintains per-sensor 30-deque sliding windows). Do not re-instantiate the service on every telemetry packet.
integration_notes.modifications_forbidden: Do NOT modify ml/models/ weights, config, scaler, or threshold. Do NOT change station scope from MTR.
